summary: Iteration 226: Tested surgical delete, clear chat recovery, SEC backup blocklist, storefront chain filter, and blockList crash fix. All features working correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: Surgical delete (_surgical_cache_purge) properly removes only the specific txid from feed cache and unpins IPFS CIDs
Clear Chat uses timestamped soft-delete (clearedBefore) instead of destroying IndexedDB caches
Recover Chat (removeClearedBefore) properly removes the clearedBefore timestamp to restore messages
SEC Backup includes blockedUsers in collectNetworkState and restores them in restoreNetworkState
Storefront chain filter uses object._blockchain field for filtering (CHAIN_FILTERS with match field)
blockList crash fixed - useBlockList hook properly initialized in AppLayout and passed to ProfileDetailPage
context_for_next_testing_agent: All features from iteration 226 are working: (1) Feed page loads without blockList crash, (2) Storefront shows chain filters (Featured, BTC, LTC, DOG, MZC, IPFS), (3) Profile detail page shows Block button for non-own profiles, (4) Auth page shows 'Unmoderated Space' content advisory, (5) DM page menu has both 'Clear Chat' and 'Recover Chat' buttons, (6) POST /api/reactions/{txid} with type=delete returns ok:true, (7) GET /api/reactions/{txid} returns deleted_by_author field.
